name: Human Stories
tagline: Warm, people-first storytelling where testimony leads the way
idea: A warm, intimate design that explains the work through the people at its centre. Testimony opens the page in large italic type beside a quiet photograph, and stories follow in a gentle zigzag of rounded images and words, on soft cream paper.
fit: Supporters and donors respond to people, not abstractions. Leading with first-person testimony builds empathy and trust, while clear labels, captions and a visible ‘How we work’ keep the research credible.
informedBy: A strong lead story and clear scanning hierarchy, not rows of equal cards
Impact told as a dated, concrete result beside clearly labelled figures
Captions and credits on every image; giving placed at meaningful points
distinct: A person’s own words, not a headline, open the page. Round portraits and zigzag story pairs bring a warmth the institutional concepts avoid.
buttons: Rounded clay pills for giving and reading; outlined cocoa pills for secondary actions; underlined clay links with an ochre line.
imageDirection: Warm golden grade, rounded corners and circular portrait crops. Quiet, dignified scenes with people seen from behind or in silhouette, always captioned and credited.
navigation: A light top bar: four visible sections, a friendly Menu for the rest, search, and a rounded clay Give button.
visualCharacter: Warm, intimate, paper-soft; big italic quotes and rounded photographs
contentEmphasis: Testimony and stories first, then impact, evidence and giving
bestFor: Growing supporters and monthly giving through empathy, while keeping research credible and findable
tradeoffs: Depends on strong, consented testimony and good photography; less dense, so researchers see fewer items per screen than in news-led concepts.
